text:
Alice Chen: quick sync: were still getting inconsistent handling of error responses from /v1/generate across SDKs. can we agree on a canonical shape?
Mateo Ruiz: we should standardize both the HTTP status + a stable machine code in the body. humans vs machines are separate concerns.
Alice Chen: proposed mapping: 400 for malformed json, 422 for prompt validation (semantic), 409 for conflict/lock, 503 for model not ready. what about partial results / fallbacks?
Priya Singh: for fallbacks we currently return 200 with a notice body. that breaks some server-side logic that assumes 200 == ideal model. Suggest 200 + warnings + a header so clients can opt into strictness.
Samir Patel: telemetry requirement: every error must include x-route-id and x-model-variant response headers so we can link routing decisions to error incidence. also add an immutable client_code string in body.
Jules (eng-console): Console needs a user_action hint to render a CTA (retry, edit_prompt, contact_support). Also we should avoid showing raw internal error codes to end users.
Alice Chen: agreed. example payload for a validation failure: 
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Prompt failed policy check: potential PII",
    "client_code": "invalid_prompt.pii_detected",
    "kind": "client",
    "user_action": "edit_prompt",
    "hint": "Remove names or identifiers",
    "docs": "https://redwood.example/docs/errors#invalid_prompt"
  }
}
```
Mateo Ruiz: small rename suggestion: use field name "kind" with enum {client,server,system} so dashboards can bucket quickly. client_code should be stable snake_case.
Priya Singh: rollout considerations: when we fallback from gptx-large to gptx-small, we need to surface that as a non-fatal event. proposal: keep 200 but add header `x-fallback: true` and `client_warning_code` in body, plus emit telemetry event fallback=true.
Samir Patel: I worry about silent failures w/200. Some customers treat any non-ideal model as a failure. Could we use 206? it's awkward for JSON APIs. I prefer 200+warnings + explicit header and telemetry.
Alice Chen: final call: 200+warnings + x-fallback header + structured telemetry event. SDKs must treat this as non-error but provide a warning callback. Console will show a banner.
Jules (eng-console): UI notes: show friendly message + action button if user_action in {retry,edit_prompt}. hide client_code, surface only docs link and hint. Also add a small badge when response had x-fallback.
Mateo Ruiz: also add x-error-schema header (e.g. x-error-schema: 2026-03) so we can evolve shape without breaking parsers. server will default schema v1.
Samir Patel: add x-client-code header mirroring body.client_code for correlation in logs that only capture headers.
Alice Chen: decision checklist:
- Body: error.message (string), error.client_code (snake_case), error.kind (client/server/system), optional error.user_action, error.hint, error.docs. warnings array allowed for non-fatal quality notes.
- HTTP codes: 4xx for client issues (422 for validation), 409 for conflict, 5xx for infra/model unavailable.
- Fallbacks: return 200 + body.warnings + headers x-fallback=true and x-model-variant; emit telemetry event fallback=true.
- Headers: x-route-id, x-model-variant, x-error-schema, x-client-code, x-fallback (when applicable).
- Console: friendly message + CTA based on user_action. do not expose client_code.
- Telemetry: emit structured event with client_code, route_id, model_variant, fallback flag.
Priya Singh: Dev note: add contract tests in api-integration that validate header presence for error responses. also add SDK tests to parse new shapes.
Mateo Ruiz: runtime: will implement mapping layer that translates internal errors -> (status, body, headers) according to RFC. will include unit tests.
Samir Patel: telemetry ticket created: INF-5423. will instrument route_id + model_variant in all error events and add fallback boolean.
Jules (eng-console): UI ticket ENG-7812 created to mock and implement banners/buttons. will avoid showing raw codes.
DeployBot: Canary deploy 2026-03-15T16:02Z: new error schema header added to canary; monitor client parsing error rates for 30m.
Alice Chen: I'll write a short RFC and link the tickets. moving this into a single implement group: runtime (Mateo), telemetry (Samir), console (Jules), SDKs (devex).
Mateo Ruiz: small follow-up: include sample curl snippets in the docs and an SDK migration guide for the x-error-schema header so customers can opt-in/out.
Priya Singh: +1. also add a short paragraph in the status page about fallback semantics for enterprise customers.
Alice Chen: thanks all. I'll post the RFC and mark this thread closed once tickets are linked.
Jules (eng-console): thanks ":thumbsup:"
Samir Patel: linking logs and will watch during rollout.
